title: Vehicle Return Option Fee, Mileage Rate, Wear Waiver and Timing Schedule (Kestrel Advantage Balloon)
content:
A Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract that carries the return option uses this schedule for the return fee, the return-fee loyalty days, the excess mileage rate, the wear waiver cap, the window in which the vehicle may come back and the periods that follow the return.

## Charges

| | Tier 5 | Tier 4 | Tier 3 | Tier 2 | Tier 1 | Tier 1+ |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Return fee charged when the vehicle is returned under the return option (USD) | 495.00 | 495.00 | 450.00 | 395.00 | 395.00 | 350.00 |
| Calendar days around the return date within which a new Kestrel retail contract or lease waives the return fee | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Charge per mile above the contract mileage allowance (USD per mile) | 0.25 | 0.25 | 0.25 | 0.25 | 0.25 | 0.25 |
| Assessed excess wear forgiven on a returned vehicle (USD) | 0.00 | 0.00 | 250.00 | 250.00 | 500.00 | 750.00 |

## Timing

| | Tier 5 | Tier 4 | Tier 3 | Tier 2 | Tier 1 | Tier 1+ |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Calendar days before the maturity date from which the vehicle may be returned | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Calendar days after the maturity date through which the vehicle may still be returned | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |
| Calendar days after the return during which the customer may dispute the return inspection | 14 | 14 | 14 | 14 | 14 | 14 |
| Calendar days after the return after which unpaid return charges are charged off | 120 | 120 | 120 | 120 | 120 | 120 |
| Calendar days after billing by which return charges are due | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |

## Notes

- The return fee is USD 495.00 on Tier 5 and Tier 4, USD 450.00 on Tier 3, USD 395.00 on Tier 2 and Tier 1 and USD 350.00 on Tier 1+.
- The wear waiver cap is 0.00 on Tier 5 and Tier 4, 250.00 on Tier 3 and Tier 2, 500.00 on Tier 1 and 750.00 on Tier 1+.
- The excess mileage rate is USD 0.25 per mile on every tier.
